mechanism.claim: opposite completed-hour BVOL and DVOL repricing identifies unresolved cross-venue volatility discovery; when a large first-half BTC shock is fully absorbed across the hourly open, the absorbing second-half flow should relay
mechanism.side: sign of the completed-hour second-half return
mechanism.why_distinct: CVDAR requires cross-venue volatility body disagreement, no OI or funding condition, and price-path confirmation; it is not CVVH shape leadership or OLIAH joint expansion with OI contraction

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility: normalized BVOL and DVOL bodies have strictly opposite nonzero signs
clock.price_source: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T), exact minute halves
clock.first_half_shock: absolute first-half return >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.absorption: second-half return has opposite nonzero sign and at least half the first-half absolute magnitude; final close crosses the hour open in second-half direction
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.vol_oi_funding: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C nonprice snapshot; OI and funding are not signal inputs
source_plan.intrahour_price: reuse hash-bound OLIAH completed-hour intrahour snapshot
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
